newsitem.title: UK: European vegetable oils little changed at close.
newsitem.headline: European vegetable oils little changed at close.

text.p: European vegetable oil prices were little changed at the close of business on Monday.
Palm oil was quiet ahead of the release on Tuesday of the Malaysian Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) end-March output, stocks and exports data.
In his last report for March Malaysian private forecaster Ivan Wong estimated local palm oil output at end-March at 665,000 tonnes, 32 percent up from end-February.
Stocks were projected at 725,000 tonnes against 722,993 tonnes in February.
At the close crude palm oil cif Europe was $2.50 up to unchanged in a tradeless market.
RBD palm oil was also up by the same amount while olein was $2.50 up to $2.50 down after Jun traded at $575 and Apr traded at $582.50 in as switch with Jul/Sep at $567.50 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Coconut oil shed it's early gains and closed $2.50 to $5 lower after Apr/May traded at $717.50, May/Jun at $712.50 and Jun/Jul at $707.50 and $705 a tonne cif in mainly dealer trading.
Palmkernel oil closed unchanged to $2.50 higher.
Volatile trading in Chicago kept the lid on soft oils with soy oil one guilders down at the close after Aug/Sep traded at 104.25 guilders a 100 kilos.
Rape oil was 0.50 to 0.25 guilders lower after tended Apr trade at 103 and Aug/Sep at 103.00, 103.25 and 103.50 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
